why: Corpus miss recorded in PR #641 (java #43): a Dockerfile COPY named target/app.jar while the pom in the same diff, with artifactId webhook-relay, version 1.4.0 and no finalName, makes Maven produce target/webhook-relay-1.4.0.jar, so the build fails at that COPY for everyone. The review reported the unpinned base image beside it instead. Dimension 7 (config/IaC) is the block that asks for every path a declarative file names to be checked against the producing build file; with dimension routing on, this case fails if a batch holding a Dockerfile and a pom stops carrying it.
prDescription: Adds a Maven build and a two-stage Dockerfile that packages the relay and runs it as a non-root user.
